one_liner: Work and project management platform for tracking tasks and team workflows.

auth.evidence_quote: OAuth is an open-standard authentication protocol that allows you to approve one application interacting with another on your behalf without providing your username and password.
auth.notes: Personal access token (PAT) is documented as a bearer token for single-user scripts, not branded 'API key'; Service Accounts are Enterprise-only long-lived tokens.

access.evidence_quote: A personal access token (PAT) is the quickest and simplest way to authenticate in the API.
access.notes: Free Asana accounts exist generally; whether API/OAuth access is gated by plan tier was not confirmed within budget.

api.evidence_quote: OAuth is an open-standard authentication protocol
api.notes: Asana has an official MCP server per general knowledge; not independently re-verified via fetch in this pass.

verdict.rationale: Documented OAuth2 and PAT authentication with no confirmed extra production gate beyond standard OAuth consent.
